title: Free-Throw Routine Reps
description: Players build and rehearse a consistent pre-shot routine at the free-throw line, repeating it the same way whether the shot goes in or not.

content.objective: Build one repeatable pre-shot routine and perform it identically on every attempt.
content.setup: Shooter stands at the free-throw line with a ball and enough space to set a routine.
instructions: Choose a simple routine: for example, two dribbles, a breath, and a spin of the ball.
Perform the exact same routine before every single attempt, make or miss.
Shoot sets of ten, recording makes without changing the routine based on results.
Finish with five free throws under simulated fatigue after a short sprint.
coachingPoints: Keep the routine identical regardless of the previous shot's result.
Breathe out right before the release to stay relaxed.
Track makes over time rather than reacting to any single miss.
commonMistakes: Changing the routine after a miss out of frustration.
Rushing the routine when tired instead of trusting it.
Rushing the release instead of trusting the mechanics.
content.safety: Keep the lane clear for a rebounder standing to the side.
